findings.finding: ENERGY-CLASS used global inhomogeneous L2-time H1 rather than L2-time homogeneous H1.
findings.repair: Changed the canonical statement to L-infinity-time L2 intersect L2-time dot H1.

findings.finding: Different claims and source-tree hashes prove undocumented modification.
findings.reason: The final-review prompt explicitly supplied separate hashes for different byte sets; no equality was expected.

findings.finding: Program-wide legacy rounds were ineligible for later target certification and lacked always-on validation.
findings.repair: Kept legacy rounds program-scoped, added an always-validated manifest, and reserved target_claim_id for future target-specific certification rounds.

findings.finding: Unresolved findings could disappear between rounds without a repair record.
findings.repair: The manifest validator now requires each prior unresolved string to remain open or appear in resolved_findings.

findings.finding: Certification roles did not match the documented scaling, PDE, and counterexample critics.
findings.repair: Target certification now requires completed known-model scaling, PDE, counterexample, source, and arbiter roles.

findings.finding: An unrelated proved lemma could masquerade as a computation bridge.
findings.repair: Added computation_bridge kind and required each bridge claim to be proved and directly depend on the mapped computation.

findings.finding: Legacy claim states cannot be reconstructed from hashes alone.
findings.repair: Introduced schema-v2 rounds with mandatory content-addressed claims snapshots beginning at round 005; pre-v2 loss remains documented.

findings.finding: Gauntlet history was checked only when a Clay target became resolved.
findings.repair: Added an always-on manifest that validates every round file, hash link, ordering, unresolved transition, and snapshot.

findings.finding: The project remains untracked and therefore lacks Git-backed durability.
findings.reason: No staging or commit was requested.

validation: round-005 claims snapshot hash equals canonical claims hash
unresolved_valid_findings: Version-control durability requires explicit user authorization to stage and commit this untracked project.
